guarantees.claim: When state is one of StAppCfg, StAppMsg, StAppOutLen, StAppProcess, StAppWait and app_id matches a valid index i (< NumAppIntf), sha3_prefix_o is assigned reg_prefix_i if AppCfg[i].PrefixMode is 0, else AppCfg[i].Prefix.
guarantees.cond: st ∈ {StAppCfg, StAppMsg, StAppOutLen, StAppProcess, StAppWait} and ∃ i < NumAppIntf with app_id == i

guarantees.claim: In the same app-specific states, if app_id does not match any i (app_id >= NumAppIntf), sha3_prefix_o stays at the initial value '0 assigned before the case.
guarantees.cond: st ∈ {StAppCfg, StAppMsg, StAppOutLen, StAppProcess, StAppWait} and app_id >= NumAppIntf

guarantees.claim: In state StSw and all other states (default branch), sha3_prefix_o is assigned reg_prefix_i.
guarantees.cond: st == StSw or st not in app-specific list

assumptions.claim: app_id must be < NumAppIntf whenever the FSM is in an app-specific state (StAppCfg..StAppWait) for the prefix to be driven correctly.
assumptions.risk: sha3_prefix_o defaults to 0, potentially breaking the SHA-3 operation by using an incorrect prefix.

assumptions.claim: NumAppIntf is expected to be > 0 if any app-specific state can be reached, otherwise the loop never executes and sha3_prefix_o stays 0 in those states.
assumptions.cond: design integrated with NumAppIntf = 0 and FSM enters an app-specific state
assumptions.risk: Silent misoperation: sha3_prefix_o = 0 instead of a configured prefix, leading to incorrect hash results.

uncertain_points.claim: When the FSM is in an app-specific state and app_id >= NumAppIntf, the design silently uses sha3_prefix_o = 0. It is unclear whether this is a legal scenario or if app_id is guaranteed to be in range. The prefix directly influences the SHA-3 computation, so an unintended value could compromise integrity or key derivation.
uncertain_points.cond: st ∈ {StAppCfg, StAppMsg, StAppOutLen, StAppProcess, StAppWait} and app_id >= NumAppIntf
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect SHA-3 prefix may cause wrong hash/PUF output, breaking security guarantees or causing silent data corruption.

uncertain_points.claim: The two prefix sources — reg_prefix_i and the per-app AppCfg[i].Prefix — are selected based on AppCfg[i].PrefixMode, but the local chunk does not indicate the security or functional difference between them. Further context is needed to verify that the selection does not open a path for a weaker or unintended prefix under attacker control.
uncertain_points.risk: An attacker could influence PrefixMode or AppCfg.Prefix to force a predictable or attacker-chosen prefix, weakening SHA-3-based authentication/encryption.
